title: Non-convex polytopes realizing kissing contact graphs in dimensions 5-7
summary: Each of the 12 known conjecturally optimal kissing configurations in dimensions 5, 6, and 7 carries a contact-graph polytope: a polytope whose vertices are the configuration points and whose edges are exactly its contacts. Eight of these polytopes are non-convex and distinct from their convex hulls, which include longer edges. Each polytope is radial about the sphere's center: its boundary meets every ray from the center exactly once. It is the unique radial polytope with those vertices and edges.
